mapper.select: SELECT sf.stored_file_id, sf.storage_scope_code, sf.storage_key FROM stored_file sf WHERE sf.storage_key LIKE 'performance/%' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM performance_public_page ppp WHERE sf.stored_file_id IN ( ppp.hero_file_id, ppp.poster_file_id, ppp.og_image_file_id ) ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public_profile pp WHERE pp.profile_file_id = sf.stored_file_id ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM performance_media pm WHERE pm.stored_file_id = sf.stored_file_id )
SELECT stored_file_id, storage_scope_code, storage_key FROM performance_file_retirement_manifest WHERE status_code = 'PENDING' ORDER BY performance_file_retirement_manifest_id

SELECT reference_type FROM ( SELECT 'asset_item' AS reference_type FROM asset_item WHERE photo_file_id = #{storedFileId} UNION ALL SELECT 'resource_file' AS reference_type FROM resource_file WHERE stored_file_id = #{storedFileId} UNION ALL SELECT 'activity_record_file' AS reference_type FROM activity_record_file WHERE stored_file_id = #{storedFileId} UNION ALL SELECT 'internal_notice_attachment' AS reference_type FROM internal_notice_attachment WHERE stored_file_id = #{storedFileId} UNION ALL SELECT 'public_notice_attachment' AS reference_type FROM public_notice_attachment WHERE stored_file_id = #{storedFileId} ) retained_reference LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO performance_file_retirement_manifest ( stored_file_id, storage_scope_code, storage_key, status_code, failure_reason, object_deleted_dttm ) VALUES ( #{storedFileId}, #{storageScope}, #{storageKey}, 'PENDING', NULL, NULL ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE storage_scope_code = VALUES(storage_scope_code), storage_key = VALUES(storage_key), status_code = CASE WHEN status_code = 'DELETED' THEN 'DELETED' ELSE 'PENDING' END, failure_reason = CASE WHEN status_code = 'DELETED' THEN failure_reason ELSE NULL END, object_deleted_dttm = CASE WHEN status_code = 'DELETED' THEN object_deleted_dttm ELSE NULL END

INSERT INTO performance_file_retirement_manifest ( stored_file_id, storage_scope_code, storage_key, status_code, failure_reason, object_deleted_dttm ) VALUES ( #{retirementFile.storedFileId}, #{retirementFile.storageScope}, #{retirementFile.storageKey}, 'SKIPPED', #{retainedReferenceType}, NULL ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE storage_scope_code = VALUES(storage_scope_code), storage_key = VALUES(storage_key), status_code = CASE WHEN status_code = 'DELETED' THEN 'DELETED' ELSE 'SKIPPED' END, failure_reason = CASE WHEN status_code = 'DELETED' THEN failure_reason ELSE VALUES(failure_reason) END
mapper.update: UPDATE performance_file_retirement_manifest SET status_code = 'DELETED', failure_reason = NULL, object_deleted_dttm = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE stored_file_id = #{storedFileId} AND status_code = 'PENDING'
